comment: Metric-view base for facilities, covenants and collateral (mv_facilities_covenants_collateral, D13): a record_type union of Facility rows (one per facility: limit, drawn, undrawn, margin - is_primary_row), Covenant Test rows (one per covenant test from FY2023: threshold, actual, headroom %, bucket, breach, waiver, is_latest_test) and Collateral rows (one per collateral item: appraised value, LTV, valuation age, review flags). Facility descriptors (type, status, security, guarantor, parent rating from the JP share) repeat on every row for slicing; each amount or flag is populated only on the row type that owns it and null elsewhere, so SUM / MIN / COUNT_IF over the base never double counts. Facility amounts are as of 30-Sep-2026. Examples: Limit USD = SUM(limit_usd); latest leverage headroom = MIN(headroom_pct) WHERE is_latest_test AND covenant_type = 'Net Debt/EBITDA'; Collateral Value USD = SUM(collateral_value_usd); weighted margin bps = SUM(margin_x_limit_usd) / SUM(limit_usd). Grain: one row per record_type x record (facility, covenant test or collateral item).
